decision.rationale: Discard from advancement: the audited seed-42 public development mean HR@10 was 0.5805 for the candidate, 0.5875 for the local-sum control, and 0.59475 for the incumbent. The candidate was below both comparators, missed its proposed >0.59975 prediction, and the host eligibility flag was false. Category contrasts were mixed; neither new arm exceeded the incumbent in aggregate. Host admission and completed frozen-protocol training support that these are development outcomes, but they do not establish a causal mechanism or confirmation performance.
unresolved_explanations: The incumbent may already encode useful local transitions; the added projection may instead change optimization or overfit.

Matched parameter counts do not equalize the distributions of local-difference and local-sum inputs. Independent initialization and validation checkpoint selection may also contribute to this single-seed contrast.

The supplied evidence does not expose explicit fixed-state nonzero-projection formula results, zero-projection equivalence to the incumbent, or post-update forward and score_candidates identity results. Finite synthetic admission and training checks do not establish those claims.
Exploratory history-length slices have positive, zero, and negative effects, but no paired candidate-control history-length contrast is supplied. No confirmation or final-test result is supplied.
